lines: Aldermere was built on trade. This gym was built on everything that came with it.
Spend wisely. Battle boldly. Those are the only two rules.
npcs.name: Sterling

trainer.name: Sterling
wait: Ah, a guest. My associates will see you first. Standard procedure.
All three, please. Then we can talk business.
say: Welcome to the gallery. Everything you see here was won, not bought.
My Pokemon are the finest collection in the east. Polished, sharp and priceless.
Impress me, and the most valuable thing in this room is yours.
say2: A repeat customer. Excellent. Let us begin.
lose: Marvellous! I have not been outbid like that in years.
The Aldermere Badge. Solid. I had it made by the best smith in the city.

lines: How rude of you to win. Go on, then.

trainer.name: Celeste
trainer.say: Shoes off at the door, darling. Oh, you have already walked in. Battle!
trainer.lose: How rude of you to win. Go on, then.

lines: I shall have to add you to my collection of regrets.

trainer.name: Hugo
trainer.say: Every Pokemon I own is one of a kind. I checked!
trainer.lose: I shall have to add you to my collection of regrets.

trainer.name: Marigold
trainer.say: I forged Sterling his badge. Let me see if you are worth one!

lines: Sterling collects steel and treasure Pokemon. They are hard to scratch, so bring fire or a punch.
His last one is worth more than this whole street.
